title: SBU detains former sailor in Odesa suspected of directing Russian attacks
summary: The Security Service of Ukraine's (SBU) military counterintelligence unit has detained a former merchant ship sailor in Odesa who is suspected of helping Russia direct its strikes.

title: Intelligence reveals details of Russian Gerbera-2 drone with range of up to 1,200 km
summary: The Ukrainian Defense Ministry's Main Intelligence Directorate (HUR) has released information about the components of the Russian Gerbera-type unmanned aerial vehicle.

title: Russian attack leaves 130 settlements without power in Zhytomyr region
summary: Russian forces attacked an energy facility in the Zhytomyr region overnight on November 3, leaving 130 settlements without electricity.

title: Russian attacks damage homes and power lines in Cherkasy, two people injured
summary: Two people were injured in a Russian drone strike on the city of Cherkasy.

title: Russia’s war casualty toll in Ukraine up by 2,060 over past day
summary: Russia’s total combat losses since the start of its full-scale invasion of Ukraine on February 24, 2022, have reached approximately 1,594,830 personnel as of November 3, 2026, including 2,060 troops killed or wounded over the past day.

title: Russian forces launch repeated strike on Dnipro, leaving people injured
summary: Russian forces launched another attack on Dnipro in the morning, damaging residential buildings and injuring civilians.

title: Ukraine intercepts 66% of Russia’s jet-powered Shahed drones in October – General Staff
summary: Ukraine’s Defense Forces destroyed 4,859 Shahed-type drones used by Russian forces to attack Ukraine during October.

title: Injury toll in Russian attack on Kharkiv rises to 62
summary: The number of people injured after a medical facility in Kharkiv’s Nemyshlianskyi district was hit has risen to 62, while more than 220 patients are being evacuated to other hospitals.

title: Putin panicking ahead of U.S. elections – Congressman Whitesides
summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin is panicking as he anticipates a change in the composition of the U.S. Congress and, together with President Donald Trump, is trying to force Ukraine into making unfavorable concessions before the newly elected Congress begins its session in January, Democratic Congressman George Whitesides believes.

title: Kharkiv hit by Russian attack, medical facility struck, casualties reported
summary: Russian forces launched a massive attack on Kharkiv with ballistic missiles and guided aerial bombs, with one of the strikes hitting a medical facility in the Nemyshlianskyi district, leaving people injured.

title: Up to four groups of power cuts scheduled across Ukraine on Tuesday – Ukrenergo
summary: Electricity consumption restrictions will be in effect in some regions of Ukraine on Tuesday, November 3, from 00:00 to 23:59.

title: Czech PM outlines army priorities for coming years
summary: The priorities for developing the Czech Armed Forces are increasing troop numbers and strengthening air defence.

title: Ukraine to establish center for return of civilian detainees
summary: Following the humanitarian mission to Oleshky, Ukraine will establish a separate Center for the Return of Civilian Citizens of Ukraine, which will operate under the Ombudsman's Office.

title: Odesa to receive 20 buses from Romania’s Galati for public transport during blackouts
summary: Odesa and the Romanian city of Galați are launching a partnership in the areas of municipal services, transportation, infrastructure restoration, culture, and education.

title: SSU identifies around 100 people involved in unrest in Petropavlivska Borshchahivka
summary: The Security Service of Ukraine (SSU) has identified around 100 people who were present during the unrest in the village of Petropavlivska Borshchahivka, Kyiv region, on November 2, including those actively involved in organizing it.

title: Zelensky outlines key topics for trilateral meeting in Abu Dhabi
summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky said that during the trilateral meeting in Abu Dhabi, the U.S. side plans to discuss security guarantees and a Recovery Package. Ukraine is also interested in discussing an energy ceasefire, unblocking the Black Sea, exchanges, and preparations for a meeting of the leaders of Ukraine, the United States and Russia.

title: Zelensky announces meetings of U.S., European and Ukrainian teams in Brussels
summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky said that meetings involving teams from Ukraine, the United States, Europe and NATO countries will be held in Brussels tomorrow, November 4, to discuss recovery packages and security guarantees.

title: Russians drop four aerial bombs on Kramatorsk, killing one and injuring five
summary: In the Donetsk region, Russian forces dropped four aerial bombs on the outskirts of Kramatorsk, killing one person and injuring five others.

title: Budget 2027 being prepared for second reading with IMF cooperation in mind: PM Koretskyi, lawmakers hold meeting
summary: A meeting was held on preparing the 2027 state budget for its second reading, attended by Prime Minister Sergii Koretskyi, parliamentary leadership, the head of the Servant of the People parliamentary faction, the chair of the Verkhovna Rada Budget Committee, and Finance Minister Serhii Marchenko.

title: Melania Trump to convene Russian and Ukrainian representatives at White House
summary: U.S. First Lady Melania Trump will host a meeting at the White House involving representatives of Ukraine and Russia to discuss the ceasefire in Oleshky, Kherson region.

title: Russian forces attack civilians on road in Sumy region with drones, woman injured
summary: Russian forces attacked civilians with drones on a road in the Velyka Pysarivka community of the Okhtyrka district, seriously injuring a woman.

title: Hungary has no new substantive objections to opening Ukraine’s final negotiation clusters – Kachka
summary: The Hungarian authorities have no new substantive objections to opening the two remaining negotiating clusters on Ukraine’s accession to the European Union.

title: Russian drone hits house in Kyiv region, 14-year-old child killed
summary: A 14-year-old child was killed in a Russian drone strike in the Kyiv region.

title: General Staff responds to events in Petropavlivska Borshchahivka
summary: Following the events in Petropavlivska Borshchahivka, the General Staff of the Ukrainian Armed Forces stressed that the processes of joining the military and returning service members after unauthorized absence from their units must be carried out in accordance with the law and with respect for human dignity.

title: Russian forces attack agricultural enterprise in Zhytomyr region, three injured
summary: Russian drones have attacked an agricultural enterprise in the Liubar community in the Zhytomyr region, injuring three people.

title: Zelensky, Merz hold talks in Berlin
summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky met with German Federal Chancellor Friedrich Merz in Berlin on Tuesday, November 3.

title: Zelensky arrives in Berlin
summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has arrived in Berlin.

title: Zelensky confirms resumption of strikes on Russian oil refineries
summary: Ukraine has resumed strikes on Russian oil refineries in response to continued Russian attacks on Ukraine's energy infrastructure.

title: Russian forces may be planning new landing attempts in Kherson's Korabel district – South Group of Forces
summary: Russian troops are making preparations that may indicate an intention to establish a foothold on the right bank of the Dnipro River in the Kherson region, build up forces in the Korabel district of Kherson, and use it as a potential bridgehead for further operations aimed at capturing the city.

title: Ukraine hacked Russia's emergency alert system in response to Russian cyberattack – Zelensky
summary: Ukraine hacked Russia's emergency alert system in response to a Russian cyberattack on November 1. The hack was a response to Russia sending fake nuclear threat warnings to Ukrainian users.

title: Death toll from Komyshuvakha airstrike rises to 31, nearly 50 people missing
summary: A search-and-rescue operation is underway at the site of an airstrike in Komyshuvakha. So far, 31 people have been confirmed killed, while nearly 50 others are missing.

title: Russian attack hits energy infrastructure in 10 regions – Energy Ministry
summary: Russia's large-scale missile and drone attack targeted power plants, substations and combined heat and power plants (CHPs) across 10 Ukrainian regions. Emergency power outages were introduced in Kyiv and six regions as a result of the damage.

title: Three DTEK power plants halt generation after large-scale Russian attack
summary: Three thermal power plants operated by DTEK Group were targeted in a Russian attack overnight into November 3.

title: FM Sybiha calls Russia’s deliberate pre-winter attacks on Ukraine’s energy infrastructure clear sign of genocide
summary: Russia’s targeted attacks on Ukraine’s energy infrastructure, aimed at depriving the population of electricity and heating on the eve of winter, are one of the direct signs of genocide.

title: Russian forces strike civilian infrastructure in Chernihiv region early in morning
summary: Early this morning, Russian troops launched a drone strike on a farm building and a house in one of the villages of the Kiptivka community in Chernihiv region.

title: Russian forces damage DTEK facility in southern Odesa region
summary: Russian troops damaged a DTEK Odesa Power Grid facility, causing power outages.

title: Drone attack sparks fire at one of Russia’s largest oil refineries in Yaroslavl, media report
summary: On the night of November 2, drones attacked the Yaroslavl Oil Refinery, one of the five largest in Russia. A fire broke out at the facility, which supplies fuel, including for military aircraft and equipment.

title: Russian attack on Dnipro injures 15, three in serious condition
summary: In Dnipro, the number of people wounded as a result of the Russian attack on the morning of November 3 has risen to 15.

title: Russian strike on Kharkiv hospital raises injury toll to 73
summary: In Kharkiv, 73 people were injured as a result of a Russian attack on the night of November 3.

title: War update: 206 clashes on front line over past day, fiercest fighting in Kostiantynivka sector
summary: A total of 206 combat engagements took place along the front line over the past day. Russian forces were most active in the Kostiantynivka sector, where they launched 21 attacks.
